concerns.text: No completed task enforces the abort when total retained samples per species are < 50 (task T064d is pending). This leaves FR‑001 uncovered.
The hard limit of 5,000 genes after CPM filtering is not enforced by any completed task (task T015 is still pending). FR‑003 remains uncovered.
Full‑set evaluation against STRING (AUROC/AUPRC on all gene‑pair scores) has no completed implementation (task T022a is pending). FR‑006 is missing.
The CI check that AUROC ≥ 0.70 and AUPRC ≥ 0.70 is not implemented (task T045c remains undone). SC‑001 cannot be verified.
No CI step ensures at least one GO term with adjusted p < 0.05 (task T044 is still pending). SC‑002 is uncovered.
The runtime‑limit CI step (abort if wall‑clock > 6 h) is not completed (task T009d is pending). SC‑003 is missing.
Verification after each Make target is defined (task T011c) but the primary validation script (T011) is not marked done, so SC‑005 may not be enforced.
R environment initialization (renv.lock, Bioconductor packages) is pending (tasks T003, T003c, T003d). Without this, FR‑002 (DESeq2/VST) cannot be satisfied.
Gene‑to‑protein identifier mapping relies on Bioconductor packages that are not yet installed (pending R environment tasks). FR‑005 lacks concrete implementation.
Central logger module `src/utils/logger.py` is missing (task T006 not done). FR‑010 and FR‑035 cannot be satisfied.
Logging of command‑line invocation, software versions, and seed (FR‑035) depends on the missing logger implementation.
Schema file `contracts/pipeline_log.schema.yaml` referenced by T098_schema does not exist, leaving FR‑030 without a concrete contract.
Task T098_schema references a non‑existent file `contracts/pipeline_log.schema.yaml`; this is a stale reference that must be removed or the schema created.
CI workflow file `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is not present (task T005 is pending), violating the reproducibility requirement in the constitution.
Quickstart steps (clone repo, set up env, run pipeline, etc.) have no associated tasks, leaving a plan element without coverage.
The plan introduces a new diagnostic ‘abort if residual batch variance > 5 %’, which is not mentioned in the specification; this adds scope not covered by any FR/SC.
